caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical bank in the form of a rectangular box labeled “ORGAN BANK” on the front, featuring ornate yellow and gold detailing with a design suggesting organ pipes and scrolling patterns. The main color of the bank is a metallic gray with golden accents. On top of the box, there are four distinct figurines: a small brown monkey dressed in a red, yellow, and blue uniform with a golden cap, sitting in the center and holding a yellow item; two white dogs with spots, one positioned to the left, sitting upright, and the other standing to the right; and a green object resembling a frog or toad in a crouched position facing forward. There is also a crank handle attached to the left side of the bank, indicating its mechanical nature. The background of the image is a plain, untextured off-white color, and the drawing is signed “Paul Kelley K.C., MO.” in cursive in the bottom right corner.
title: Toy Bank
